title: Upsampler
text: Upsample by adding zeros between input samples, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples} sets Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples; {Upsample factor (L)} sets the upsampling factor, {Sample offset (0 to L-1)}, {Enable reset input port} sets the option to enable reset input port and {Enable ready output port} sets the option to enable ready output port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Upsample factor (L)
params.values: Upsampling factor 3 (default) | integer in the range [1, 2.^16]

params.name: Sample offset (0 to L-1)
params.values: Sample offset 0 (default) | integer in the range [0, 2.^16 – 1]

params.name: Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples
params.values: Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples 1 (default) | factor or multiple of Upsample factor (L) | integer in the range [1, Inf]

params.name: Enable reset input port
params.values: Option to enable reset input port off (default) | on

params.name: Enable ready output port
params.values: Option to enable ready output port off (default) | on
